citation.authors: F. Hipolito, A. Taghizadeh, T. G. Pedersen

digitization.method: 122 vertices of the published PDF vector polyline, olive curve RGB(0.70196,0.52941,0); axes calibrated from printed ticks, affine x and log10-y; no response interpolation, smoothing or fitted amplitude
digitization.uncertainty_scope: Retained conservative tick/stroke envelope, not statistical CI, quadrature error or author interpolation uncertainty

normalization.sigma3_choice: literal printed Fig3 unit; not the numerically evaluated definition
normalization.field_definition: E(t)=mathcalE exp(-i omega t)+c.c.; mathcalE=E_ph/2. j_plus(3omega)=Sigma_F mathcalE^3=sigma_paper (E_ph)^3, hence Sigma_F=8 sigma_paper. Assumes the plotted coefficient follows published Eqs2/5. This does not establish the authors actual Fig3 generator normalization.
normalization.absolute_normalization_qualification: UNRESOLVED: formal Eq2/5 conversion is explicit; Fig3 generator unavailable, no inferred factor-four correction

separate_formula_issue.scope: Existing independent Dirac audits: literal A4d with the stated two spins/two valleys gives a cubic coefficient four times printed Eqs10/11b/12. This is independent of the sigma3 numerical unit discrepancy; it is not proof about author code or permission to rescale curves.

compatibility.model: same gapless nearest-neighbor two-orbital graphene, bond1.42Angstrom/hopping-3eV; equivalent embedded Bloch Hamiltonian
compatibility.spin: paper states g=2; WN one-spin model displayed times2
compatibility.paper_integration: full-dispersion BZ sum; author quadrature nodes/budget not supplied
compatibility.WN_integration: six original K/Kprime folded rectangles, BZ fraction0.5657239247980235; no selected-area renormalization, no boundary correction
compatibility.paper_frequency_prescription: adiabatic omega+i eta, hbar eta=0.01eV; cumulative harmonic widths eta,2eta,3eta
compatibility.WN_frequency_prescription: distribution_broadening/Lorentzian; resonance0.01eV, low-frequency0.01eV, intermediate0.001eV; eta_correction=false; exact Fermi-Dirac derivatives
compatibility.paper_orbital_gauge: paper embedded nearest-neighbor structure factor; exact author implementation unavailable
compatibility.WN_orbital_gauge: Convention II plus explicit point-orbital positions
compatibility.paper_separate_intermediate_parameter: not supplied as the current WN independent0.001eV control
